name: vertical-hero
description: Product-page hero for the verticals: copy on the left over a composed stage — a faded dashboard, a person cut-out, three floating item cards joined by connector lines, and a panda badge. Live: the `#ap-hero` section on Fire, Police, Public Works, Local Government, K-12 and Higher Education.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the title. Renders as the page H1, as on live; without it the title becomes the H1.

title_accent.description: Part of the title painted with the brand gradient. Must appear in title.

cta_label.description: Button text. Renders only with cta_url.

badges.description: Compliance badges beside the button. Each: image, alt.

dashboard.description: Faded dashboard screenshot behind the stage.

layout.description: Placement of dash, person and badge as percentages of the stage: x, y, w, h on desktop and mx, my, mw, mh on phones. Also accepts a mobcards box.

cards.description: Up to three floating item cards (amber, sky, indigo by slot). Each: label, title, status_label, tag, icon (URL) or icon_svg, avatar (optional), tone (optional: amber, sky, indigo, purple, orange or rose — overrides the slot colour so the circle and tag follow the icon), and position x, y (desktop %) and mx, my (phone %).

lines.description: Connector lines on the desktop stage, each [x1, y1, x2, y2] in a 1440 by 550 space. The dot sits at the second point.

lines_m.description: Connector lines on phones, each [x1, y1, x2, y2] in a 360 by 680 space.

orbs.description: Soft colour glows on the desktop stage. Each: cx, cy, rx, ry (1440 by 550 space) and a hex fill.

orbs_m.description: Soft colour glows on phones (360 by 680 space).

mobile_cards.description: Phone-only composite image of the floating cards; the DOM cards hide below 700px.

features.description: Chips in a strip under the stage. Each: label; icon (URL) or icon_svg.

features_style.description: overlay lays the chips over the bottom of the stage (Emergency Preparedness); band puts them in a full-width ruled band under the hero (the product pages, live .ap-hero-feats-band).

tablet.description: 768-1180px: scale shrinks the whole hero with the viewport (Fire and most product pages); overlay keeps the copy at full size over the visual (Police).

m_top.description: Below 768px: px from the top of the hero to the first line of copy (live: 72 on Fire, 24 on Local Government, 16 on K-12).

m_flow.description: Below 768px, a hero whose height follows its copy (K-12): pad_px + pad_vw is the space under the copy, and the visual is an art_vw-tall box anchored to the bottom. Layer m* geometry is then a percentage of that box. Empty keeps the fixed 360/680 phone hero.
